description: This source file implements HTTP proxy session processing functions, specifically handling server buffer retrieval, query processing, data reception, connection closure, message sending, and server connection logic for an HTTP proxy session object.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE HttpPsoGetServerBuffer(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Retrieves the buffer handle for receiving data from the server. Currently returns NULL, indicating no specific buffer is allocated.

methods.name: ULONG HttpPsoQueryForServer(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hBufferContext)
methods.description: Determines the processing mode for incoming server data based on current message and session states, returning modes like forward, collect, or process.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpPsoRecvFromServer(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hBufferContext)
methods.description: Processes received payloads from the server, passing data to the current BMO reply object for further processing and updating session state accordingly.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpPsoFinishedByServer(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hBufferContext)
methods.description: Handles the closure of server connection, finalizing the reply object state and freeing buffers when no more data is expected.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpPsoSendToServer(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hMessage,ULONG ulSendFlags)
methods.description: Sends a request message to the server, outputting headers and body according to specified flags, and managing the transmission interface.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpPsoConnectToServer(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the server using WAM interface, hostname resolution, and socket creation, updating session state accordingly.
